text.p: Case Corp said it completed its previously announced acquisition of 75 percent of the common shares of Steyr Landmaschinentechnik GmbH, an Austrian tractor manufacturer.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company will be known as Case Steyr Landmaschinentechnik AG.
The former parent company, Steyr-Daimler-Puch AG will retain a 25 percent interest.

"The addition of the Steyr line perfectly complements our existing product offering and provides our customers, especially in the mountainous regions of several European countries, with an outstanding tractor to increase their productivity," Jean-Pierre Rosso, Case chairman, said in a statement. "This acquisition builds upon our year-old sourcing agreement with Steyr."
He added the company plans to continue to offer the tractors under both the Case and Steyr brands.
